## File: berriai_litellm/litellm/llms/minimax/chat/transformation.py

Prompts

```
['get the MiniMax API key from environment variable or parameter fallback', 'get the MiniMax API base URL defaulting to the international endpoint', 'build the complete MiniMax chat completions URL from base URL components', 'return messages and tools unchanged since MiniMax supports cache_control', 'get the list of supported OpenAI-compatible parameters for a MiniMax model']
```

Usage

```
{'get_api_key': 'get the MiniMax API key from environment variable or parameter fallback', 'get_api_base': 'get the MiniMax API base URL defaulting to the international endpoint', 'get_complete_url': 'build the complete MiniMax chat completions URL from base URL components', 'remove_cache_control_flag_from_messages_and_tools': 'return messages and tools unchanged since MiniMax supports cache_control', 'get_supported_openai_params': 'get the list of supported OpenAI-compatible parameters for a MiniMax model'}
```
